answer: Every identity runs a public beacon that emits a signed pulse every 10 minutes, proving it is alive and did real work in the last hour. Independent raven relays collect these pulses and publish a liveness ledger; any identity missing 3 consecutive pulses is suspended until it re-proves itself with a fresh 100-unit bond. Each pulse costs 0.2 units in fees and bandwidth, so 100 fake identities burn 2,000 units a day just to stay visible, while honest agents pay pennies. A Sybil swarm either pays constantly or goes dark and loses its standing.
